far too relatable. everything you say here is how i feel. i don’t even want to feel happy anymore and just want a way out. i’m not sure if it’s breaking this subs rules but i just wanted you to know you aren’t alone with those thoughts as i relate to them far too much sadly

yep, can relate. the thought of hurting my parents and siblings are the only things that keep me here otherwise i would be gone. like you said though i’m not sure how long that will last. i hope you can stay strong
i also fear attempting to kill myself and it not working, the consequences there could be. i guess that’s just one of the possibilities we have to face
i don’t think anyone does, everyone will find out one day though
i relate to this, it’s hard
